scientific_integrity.computational_check: 450 direct binomial-character comparisons, direct block sums for 151 shifts at depths one through five, 1999 stabilized-remainder and extremal tests, and complete signed shift spectra at depths one through five.
scientific_integrity.limitations: No claim for other primes, uniformly moving shifts, or arbitrary finite index intervals; no independent mathematical audit.
scientific_integrity.proof_method: Lucas digit factorization, exact carry recurrence, and signed/unsigned two-state transfer matrices.
scientific_integrity.proven_scope: Every fixed nonnegative shift for unwrapped complete base-five index blocks, and every finite shift spectrum 0<=h<5^r of the limiting correlation.

title: A complete signed correlation spectrum for Franel numbers modulo five
